welcome:
Hello {full_name} 👋

Welcome to the bot.
Please use the menu below 👇
renew_choose: 👇 Please choose a subscription to renew:
renew_not_allowed:
🛑 You cannot renew your subscription right now.
1- Less than {max_days} days must remain until your subscription ends.
2- Your remaining volume must be less than {max_gb} GB.
no_service_for_renew: ❌ You have no active subscription to renew.
renew_session_expired: ⏳ Your renewal session has expired. Please start again.
renew_auto_done: ⚡️ After payment approval, your subscription is renewed automatically.
no_active_service:
❌ You have no active service.
💡 To buy a new service, tap "💳 Buy subscription".
card_receipt_intro: ❗️ After transferring, send us a screenshot of the transaction.
card_receipt_done: ⚡️ After approval, your subscription is created and delivered automatically.
pay_receipt_prompt: ⬇️ Please send your payment receipt below this message:
pay_receipt_photo_prompt: 📤 Please send a photo of the payment receipt.
pay_receipt_invalid: ❌ Please send a photo of the receipt.
pay_receipt_pending:
✅ Your transaction is awaiting admin approval.
Please wait and avoid sending duplicate receipts.
no_card: ❌ No payment card has been registered.
btn_expired_rebuy: ❌ This button has expired. Please start the purchase again.
btn_expired_rerenew: ❌ This button has expired. Please start the renewal again.
wallet_no_method: 🚫 No top-up method is currently available.
wallet_topup_prompt: 🔻 Please enter the amount you want to charge (in Toman):
wallet_low: ❌ Your wallet balance is not enough. Please top up your wallet first.
trial_server_unavailable: ❌ No server is available for the free trial.
trial_already_msg: 🚫 You have already received a free trial.
trial_name_prompt: ✍️ Please enter a name for your trial subscription:
guide_title:
Connection guide:
Import the subscription link into your client app.
not_allowed_now: ❌ This action is not available at this step.
